description: This file defines a Java class 'AjaxPageableResponse' which extends 'AjaxResponse' and provides functionality for paginated AJAX responses including serializing data to JSON format.

classes.name: AjaxPageableResponse
classes.description: A class representing a paginated AJAX response with JSON serialization, extending 'AjaxResponse'.

methods.name: getStartRow
methods.description: Returns the starting row index for the paginated data.

methods.name: setStartRow
methods.description: Sets the starting row index for the paginated data.

methods.name: getEndRow
methods.description: Returns the ending row index for the paginated data.

methods.name: setEndRow
methods.description: Sets the ending row index for the paginated data.

methods.name: getTotalRow
methods.description: Returns the total number of rows available.

methods.name: setTotalRow
methods.description: Sets the total number of rows available.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the AJAX response, including pagination info and data, into a JSON string.
